items.title: Bitcoin on Fire: Frenzy Intensifies as $6.8 Billion Floods Into Crypto ETFs in Just 6 Weeks
items.summary: Six straight weeks of institutional money flooding into Bitcoin ETFs pushed BTC up 24% in a month, but something just broke the streak and now the entire rally hangs on a single data point yet to print.
